sloka: तस्यास्तदद्भुतप्रख्यं श्रुत्वा हर्षमुपागतः ।स वै कामी सह तया रेमे चन्द्रमसः सुतः ।। ७.८९.७ ॥
transliteration: tasyāstadadbhutaprakhyaṁ śrutvā harṣamupāgataḥ ।sa vai kāmī saha tayā reme candramasaḥ sutaḥ ।। 7.89.7 ॥

translations.english: Hearing her wonderful words, the son of the Moon, filled with desire, indeed rejoiced and enjoyed himself with her.
